timing_note: Frozen after T+T ensemble outcomes, before training Q-PLE or midrank members on this panel.
control: T+T with the same two members, per-member gradient-bearing parameter budget, architecture, seeds, optimizer, and epoch budget.
selection: Choose T+Q or T+midrank by lower validation loss; do not tune ensemble weights.
validation_gate: The validation-selected heterogeneous pair must beat T+T in at least 7/12 cells, have positive mean paired validation gain overall and within both task families, and each individual heterogeneous pair must have positive overall mean gain.
test_role: Developmental; promote only to a new prospective panel if the validation gate passes.
